records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: A75 year old man presents to ED complaining of abdominal pain radiating to his back, anorexia and weight loss. Imaging shows a large tumour of the neck of the pancreas. Which of the following structures is most likely compressed by the tumour:
records.explanation: The portal vein is formed from the union of the superior mesenteric and splenic veins posterior to the neck of the pancreas and would most likely be compressed by a tumour at this location. oo |e a Vv
warnings: No marked correct option was detected.

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww The termination of the abdominal aorta can be visualised on the anterior abdominal wall by a point:
options: Halfway between the xiphisternum and the umbilicus 3%
Halfway between the umbilicus and the pubic symphysis 8%
About 2.5 cm above the deep inguinal ring %
records.explanation: The main terminal branches of the abdominal aorta are the two common iliac arteries. This bifurcation can be visualised on the anterior abdominal wall as a point approximately 2.5 cm below the umbilicus. : v

records.stem: ww Which of the following structures does NOT pass through the inguinal canal:

The inguinal canal contains: e the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve (within the spermatic cord in men) e the spermatic cord in men e the round ligament in women e the ilioinguinal nerve (passes through part of the canal, exiting the superficial inguinal ring with the other contents) . / Vv

records.stem: w The spleen occupies which of the following abdominal regions:
records.explanation: The spleen lies in the left hypochondrium of the abdomen. . Vv

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The ejaculatory duct is formed by the union of which of the following structures:
options: Ductus deferens and the prostatic urethra 4%
Ductus deferens and duct from the seminal vesicle
Prostatic ducts and duct from seminal vesicle 48%
records.explanation: The ejaculatory duct is formed where the duct from the seminal vesicle joins the ductus deferens. The ejaculatory duct penetrates through the prostate gland to connect with the prostatic urethra. v

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: ww Regarding the female urethra, which of the following statements is CORRECT:
options: The urethra is longer in women than it is in men. 1%
The urethra begins at the apex of the bladder. 10%
The urethra opens in the vestibule that lies between the labia minora.
The inferior aspect of the urethra is bound to the posterior surface of the vagina. 4%
The internal urethral sphincter surrounds the urethra as it passes through the pelvic floor. 13%
records.explanation: In women the urethra is short (about 4 cm long), beginning at the base of the bladder. It passes inferiorly through the urogenital diaphragm into the perineum before opening in the vestibule that lies between the labia minora. The inferior aspect of the urethra is bound to the anterior surface of the vagina and the urethral opening is anterior to the vaginal opening in the vestibule. The external urethral sphincter surrounds the urethra as it passes through the pelvic floor. 7 v

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The arterial supply of the duodenum is primarily derived from which of the following:
options: Superior mesenteric and inferior mesenteric artery 7%
Left gastric artery and splenic artery 13%
Left gastric and superior mesenteric artery 13%
records.explanation: The arterial supply of the duodenum is primarily from the pancreaticoduodenal arteries, branches of the superior mesenteric artery and the gastroduodenal artery (branch of the common hepatic artery from the coeliac trunk). ° “ v

records.subject: Anatomy
records.stem: The union of the common bile duct and the pancreatic duct forms which of the following: Cystic duct (x) Hepatic duct Sphincter of Oddi Major papilla
records.explanation: As the common bile duct descends, it passes posterior to the first part of the duodenum before joining with the pancreatic duct from the pancreas, forming the hepatopancreatic ampulla (ampulla of Vater) at the major duodenal papilla, located in the second part of the duodenum.
warnings: Fewer than two answer options were detected.
